subtitle: Lesson 15 · Core ITIL 4 Practices: Incident, Problem & Change

code:
Purpose: reduce the likelihood and impact of
incidents by identifying actual and potential
causes, and managing workarounds and known errors.

Problem = a cause, or potential cause,
of one or more incidents.

The job: root cause. Not speed.
caption: Depth over speed — the opposite trade-off from incident management.

steps.label: Problem identification
steps.sub: spotting problems, often from a trend across incidents or a major incident review

steps.label: Problem control
steps.sub: analyzing root cause and assigning the problem priority

steps.label: Error control
steps.sub: managing a known error and its workaround through to a permanent fix

code:
Problem --> analyzed --> root cause understood
   |
   v
Known error: cause is known, permanent fix
not yet in place (needs a patch, budget,
or a scheduled change)
   |
   v
Workaround tracked until the real fix lands
caption: A known error links back to the incidents it explains, forward to the change that closes it.

subtitle: The fix a known error needs still has to go through a real process.
